about: The kind of page each route is, as src/lib/page-markdown.mjs pageKind says. The Python port that writes test dumps (tests/llms_dump.py page_kind) is held to the same table, by src/lib/agent-md/test/dump.test.mjs and by tests/test_generate_llms.py. Routes are written as routes.json writes them: no slashes around them. fullTextKinds are the kinds whose copies a dump holds (FULL_TEXT_KINDS in both).
